'''Wasabi Mizuta''' (Japanese: '''水田わさび''' ''Mizuta Wasabi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Mizuta was born on August 4, 1975 in {{wp|Mie Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She began working on the {{pkmn|animated series}} at the start of {{aniseries|BW}}, with her most notable role being that of [[Ash's Pignite]]. Mizuta is currently affiliated with {{wp|Aoni Production}}.
